items.sentence: Great Ormond Street Hospital says it is used mainly for sickness caused by chemotherapy or radiotherapy, and also after operations.
StatPearls describes ondansetron as a selective 5-HT3 receptor antagonist whose anti-sickness effect is thought to come mainly from blocking receptors outside the brain.
items.note: search summary of StatPearls ondansetron / 5-HT3 chapters

items.sentence: The same source describes an additional action on 5-HT3 receptors in the area postrema, a region of the brain stem.
items.note: summary: central effects mediated by antagonism of 5-HT3 receptors in area postrema

items.sentence: StatPearls says product labelling warns about combining these medicines with other medicines that act on serotonin, although the evidence is limited.
Feelings of warmth or flushing, mainly in the head or over the stomach
The same prescribing sheet says low blood potassium and magnesium should be corrected before ondansetron is used.
items.note: search summary of Notts APC sheet

items.sentence: MedlinePlus lists chest pain, shortness of breath, fainting, vision loss and a fast, slow or irregular heartbeat as symptoms that need medical help right away; in the UK, call 999 in an emergency.
items.note: MedlinePlus search summary; 999 is site signposting
